verdict.rationale: Activepieces documents a catalog of prebuilt integrations ("pieces") covering roughly 760+ apps, free on every plan, cloud or self-hosted. That is hundreds rather than the thousands the story asks for, and nothing in the evidence says who builds or maintains these pieces. Missing for 10: catalog breadth in the thousands, evidence that integrations are vendor-maintained, independent corroboration of connector quality and coverage.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can connect to thousands of apps through prebuilt, vendor-maintained integrations

citations.quote: Move data, send messages and update records between 763 apps without writing glue code. Free on every plan, cloud or self-hosted.
